name: Kōzaki (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kōzaki town emblem in red: an outlined ring crossed by a horizontal bar with a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Kōzaki, a town in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1957.

features.role: Kōzaki town emblem — an outlined ring crossed by a horizontal bar with a stylised character
